newsitem.title: USA: Wilmington Trust silver stocks edge up in week.
newsitem.headline: Wilmington Trust silver stocks edge up in week.

text.p: Wilmington Trust deliverable silver stocks rose 1,001 ounces to 58,265,903 ounces in the week ended November 25, the COMEX division of the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said on Tuesday.
Wilmington Trust in Delaware becomes an official exchange silver depositary from January 1, 1997.
NYMEX will report Wilmington Trust data weekly until January 2, 1997 when Wilmington's eligible and registered silver stocks will be reported in the exchange's daily metal warehouse data.
COMEX silver warehouse stocks, excluding Wilmington Trust silver stocks, rose 582,816 ounces on Monday to 147,853,964 ounces, a rise of 5,460,609 ounces for the week.
